decisions.decision: Freeze HPC2 N/O canonical features; Table1 N4.09/O3.54, abstract O4.09/N3.54. Fig4 has no resolving atomiclabels.
Table1 CF maps to its own unresolved registration, not raw CF or CF-0; do not propagate its XPS.
rho=1/(Vt+1/2), author assumed truecarbon density, not measured packing density. Keep mass/volume tasks separate, same source/test quarantine.
Keep289.1F/cm3@10Ag report; Fig7c mass endpoint comparison still requires bounded digitization. No select-by-highest.
Literal20/40kWkg body22 vs Fig9e axispoints unresolved. Preserve reports, not silently convert to W/kg using guessed current.
AC5 at.5Ag has Cs106.0/Cd26.5 vs89.9/22.5; CV5 has106/26.5 vs102.7/25.7. Freeze these nominal overlaps, do not invent replicate batches. Other noncompeting currents remain specific reported inputs.
Select SI_S6 explicitGCD216.6@1Ag andCV219.4@5mVs; preserve conclusion219.4@1Ag as method-conflicting prose.
Table4+SI_S2 AC1 BET539±16 vs conclusionlowerbound586. Keep specificAC1 own table539, preserve586 as unbound range dissent.
AC5 .01Hz body84 vsSI82 retained as EIS competition, not GCD label or pretest feature.
Integrated-area ID/IG is its own feature; not generic peak-intensity ID/IG. Rounded area ratios are not replaced by exact division.
All2E, Cs=4Cd representations of same device. Author m active not explicit totalboth; newreportedpurposes separate from physicallyunified device targets. Current denominator remains unknown.
± statistic unspecified; mean and author± separate. AC1 DFTarea_in_pores0 does not mean nonporous or microporearea0.
92.3/5000/1Ag appliesTi+IL+filterpaper charged1V; no3.5V substitution. Non-aqueouscycle candidate remains pending, no ordinaryaqueousqualification.
